meta.title: Short "Statement with cold open" (9:16)
meta.summary: An attitude sentence as cold open, the logo sting full screen, who speaks, and the argument or story with B-roll and captions.

concept.idea: A vertical short around one statement: the attitude sentence (2–4 s) opens cold, the logo sting follows full screen, a lower third names who speaks, then the argument or story with B-roll and captions; it ends with the animal scream and the logo end.

references.note: Analysis of the Loud Society shorts (yt-shorts/04 and 05: sting with >brazil, lower third name + handle, phrase captions): doc/mvp/brand/ANALYSIS_YOUTUBE_SHORTS.md

briefing.question: Who speaks (name and handle for the lower third)?
Word captions (brand-word) or phrase captions (brand-phrase)? Word captions need word timings.

material.label: The attitude sentence and the argument or story
B-roll for the argument or story

sections.title: Cold open
sections.purpose: The attitude sentence with captions; no lower third.
notes: One caption overlay for the whole short: caption_word (style brand-word) or caption_phrase (style brand-phrase).

sections.title: Sting
sections.purpose: logo_sting full screen (suffix optional, e.g. brazil), video and audio clip.

sections.title: Argument / story
sections.purpose: Footage and B-roll with the captions; optional wordmark flash.

logo_sting.role: full screen after the statement sentence; suffix optional

groups.note: one caption overlay matching captions.json style

hook.note: statement sentence 2–4 s before the sting

music.note: the brand pack ships no music (T14)

rules.text: One caption style per short: mixed word and phrase captions are not supported yet (one style per captions.json).
